name: Jar
summary: In the Tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. This jar was an example of a mass-produced type to be found in most households. In areas where the yellowish glaze runs thin it tends to burn to an opaque chocolate brown colour
